generator_cmd:
python3 (Pillow 16x9 JPEG photo.jpg; dpkt.pcap.Writer 5 packets cap.pcap); truncate -s 2M mbr.img && printf 'label: dos
start=63, size=1000, type=83
start=2048, size=2000, type=7
' | sfdisk mbr.img; dd conv=notrunc photo.jpg@32256 cap.pcap@1049600
oracle_cmd: binwalk mbr.img (JPEG@32256, Libpcap@1049600) + sfdisk --json mbr.img (p1 start 63, p2 start 2048) + sha256sum of the source files
